items.raw_excerpt: Kulapat Yantrasast, Why Architecture founder, has created a three-storey Los Angeles home filled with art, exposed concrete and spaces that open to the garden.
items.summary_en: Kulapat Yantrasast, founder of Why Architecture, has designed a three-story Los Angeles home filled with art and exposed concrete. The Venice Beach house features spaces that open to the garden, blending indoor and outdoor living. The design shows how architecture can unite art, nature, and natural light.

items.raw_excerpt: CIFF not only brings the world to the Midcoast, but highlights stories from our own backyard, too.
items.summary_en: The Camden International Film Festival brings global cinema to Maine's Midcoast while also showcasing stories from the local community. The festival highlights films made by and about people in the region.

items.raw_excerpt: Presidentes do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, ministro Kassio Nunes Marques, e do Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de Roraima, desembargador Mozarildo Cavalcanti, participaram de uma série de atividades na comunidade indígena Maturuca.
items.summary_en: Officials from Brazil's Superior Electoral Court and Roraima's Regional Electoral Court traveled to the Raposa Serra do Sol indigenous territory. They took part in a series of activities at the Maturuca indigenous community to connect with local residents.

items.raw_excerpt: Mark Farrant didn't expect to experience trauma from serving on a jury, but experts say there needs to be more awareness of mental health risks for those called to complete their "civic duty" in the courts.
items.summary_en: Mark Farrant was surprised by the trauma he experienced while serving on jury duty. Experts say more awareness is needed about the mental health risks jurors face when completing their civic duty in courts.

items.raw_excerpt: Power cuts disrupt Punjab's rice mills, prompting criticism of AAP's 'Roshan Punjab' promise and calls for urgent solutions.
items.summary_en: Long power cuts have stopped many rice mills from working in Punjab. Opposition leader Opon Singh blamed the AAP government for breaking its 'Roshan Punjab' promise. Farmers and mill owners say the outages are ruining their harvest season.
items.summary_ko: 펀자브 주에서 장시간 전기가 끊겨 많은 쌀 가공공장이 가동을 멈췄다. 야당 지도자 오판 싱이는 AAP 정부가 '로샨 펀자브' 공약을 지키지 않았다고 비판했다. 농민과 공장주들은 정전으로 수확 시즌에 큰 피해를 보고 있다고 호소하고 있다.
items.title_en: Power cuts shut down Punjab rice mills
items.title_ko: 펀자브 쌀 가공공장, 정전에 멈춰
items.title_original: Power cuts paralyse Punjab rice mills; Opon. slams AAP over ‘Roshan Punjab’ promise

items.raw_excerpt: Puerto Montt y China logran convenio en tecnología y comercio para combatir el desempleo
items.summary_en: The southern Chilean city of Puerto Montt has signed a technology and commerce agreement with China. The deal aims to create jobs and reduce unemployment in the region. Officials say the partnership will bring new investment and business opportunities to the area.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 남부 도시 푸에르토몬트가 중국과 기술 및 무역 협약을 체결했습니다. 이 협약은 해당 지역의 실업률을 줄이고 일자리를 창출하는 것이 목표입니다. 관계자들은 이번 파트너십이 지역에 새로운 투자와 비즈니스 기회를 가져올 것으로 기대하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Puerto Montt and China Sign Tech and Trade Deal to Fight Unemployment
items.title_ko: 푸에르토몬트, 실업 해결 위해 중국과 기술·무역 협약 체결
items.title_original: Puerto Montt y China logran convenio en tecnología y comercio para combatir el desempleo

items.raw_excerpt: Mirante de Santana registrou 75,4 mm de chuva entre 9h de sexta-feira (11) e 9h deste sábado (12). Segundo o Inmet, esse foi o maior volume acumulado em 24 horas de todo o Brasil no período.
items.summary_en: São Paulo, Brazil, has already received almost 200mm of rain in September 2026. The Mirante de Santana station recorded 75.4mm in 24 hours, the highest single-day total in the country this period according to Inmet.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 상파울루에서 2026년 9월 강수량이 거의 200mm에 이르렀다. 상파울루 북부 마란티 드 산타나 관측소는 24시간 동안 75.4mm의 비가 내려, 국립기상원 추산 전국 최고 기록을 세웠다.
items.title_en: São Paulo sees near-record September rainfall
items.title_ko: 상파울루, 9월 강수량 200mm 근접
items.title_original: Capital paulista já acumula quase 200 mm de chuvas em setembro

items.raw_excerpt: Faced with typhoons, long growing cycles and limited scale, Hainan’s durian growers are betting on technology and premium fruit rather than trying to match Southeast Asia on volume.
items.summary_en: Durian growers in Hainan face typhoons, long growing cycles, and limited scale. They are betting on technology and premium fruit instead of trying to match Southeast Asia on volume. This story explores if Hainan can nurture its own industry for the king of fruits.
items.summary_ko: 하이난의 두리안 농부들은 태풍과 긴 재배 주기, 제한된 규모의 어려움에 직면해 있다. 그들은 물량 경쟁 대신 기술과 프리미엄 과일에 베팅하며 특화된 산업을 만들려 하고 있다. 중국 하이난이 두리안의 새로운 산업 기지로 성장할 수 있을지 주목된다.
items.title_en: China's durian dream: Can Hainan nurture a homegrown industry?

items.title_original: China’s durian dream: Can Hainan nurture a homegrown industry for the king of fruits?

items.raw_excerpt: Helloween demostró con fuerza que 40 años no son nada
items.summary_en: German power metal band Helloween returned to Chile for their 40th anniversary tour. The sold-out show at Santander Arena featured classic songs, pyrotechnics, and a duet-style performance by vocalists Michael Kiske and Andi Deris. Chilean progressive metal group Polímetro opened the night.

items.title_en: Helloween proves 40 years means nothing at Santiago concert
items.title_ko: 할로윈, 산티아고 공연에서 40년은 아무것도 아니라고 증명하다

items.summary_en: Charlie Guiver, 14, from Margaret River started welding at age two. He now creates sculptures from scrap metal and recently sold one piece for $8,000. The young artist honed his skills entirely outside of school.

items.raw_excerpt: West Bengal revives Chandannagar’s French heritage with annual festival and restoration projects to boost tourism and cultural ties.
items.summary_en: The West Bengal government signed a deal with the French Embassy to restore old French buildings in Chandannagar, a former French trading post on the Ganges. An annual French festival will now be held in the town, which still has 99 colonial-era structures to preserve. Tourism officials hope the project will turn the small riverside town into an international destination.
items.summary_ko: 서벵갈 주정부가 프랑스 대사관과 협약을 맺고 갠지스강변 소도시 찬단나가르의 프랑스 식민지 시절 건물들을 복원한다. 이 도시에는 프랑스 유산 건물 99채가 남아 있으며, 매년 프랑스 축제가 열릴 예정이다. 주정부는 이 프로젝트를 통해 강변 소도시를 국제 관광지로 발전시킨다는 계획이다.
items.title_en: West Bengal restores Chandannagar's French heritage buildings

items.raw_excerpt: A mineira de 30 anos venceu a final do C1 (canoagem individual) com o tempo de 103s85. Compleram o pódio a espanhola Miren Lazkano (104s55) com a prata, e a tcheca Tereza Kneblova (104s64) com o bronze.
items.summary_en: Brazil's Ana Sátila, 30, won the C1 individual canoe final at a stage of the Canoe Slalom World Cup with a time of 103.85 seconds. Spain's Miren Lazkano took silver and the Czech Republic's Tereza Kneblova took bronze.
